title: AI Foundry lab, 2 October 2026: what changed
description: The lab dashboard live once a second with hour, day and week history; aifoundry2's card watched through an idle thermal runaway to 138 °C, explained and taken out of service; aifoundry1's card 0 back in service after its fan was replaced; new users start in three steps (their own account, Claude on the lab machine, one line).
